title: Understand your business
description: We start with a conversation about your business, your customers and what is slowing you down.
activities: Listen to your goals and challenges
Review your website, marketing and everyday tools
Choose the problem to solve first
deliverable: A clear summary of your priorities.
input: Your goals, current challenges and access to relevant information.

title: Make a practical plan
description: Together, we decide what to work on, what success looks like and what fits your budget.
activities: Agree the work and the tools needed
Set responsibilities and a realistic schedule
Confirm costs and how progress will be measured
deliverable: An agreed scope, schedule and cost breakdown.
input: Feedback on the plan and approval before work begins.

title: Build what you need
description: We create or improve the website, campaigns and customer tools included in your plan.
activities: Build the agreed pages and campaigns
Set up customer records and enquiry forms
deliverable: Working pages, campaigns or tools ready for testing.
input: Brand materials, business information and feedback on drafts.

title: Connect and test
description: We connect the agreed tools so information reaches the right people and follow-ups are easier to manage.
activities: Connect forms, customer records and communication channels
Set up agreed reminders and handovers
deliverable: Tested connections and a clear follow-up process.
input: Approved account access and a team member to test the setup.

title: Launch and improve
description: Once the work is live, we review the available results and agree what needs attention.
activities: Launch after the agreed checks and approval
Review enquiries, customer actions or workflow results
Make improvements within the agreed scope
deliverable: A progress review and a prioritised list of improvements.
input: Feedback from your team and access to agreed reporting.

title: Choose the next step
description: We use what we have learned to decide whether to expand, improve the current setup or keep it steady.
activities: Review what is working and what needs support
Explain the setup and hand over useful documentation
Agree any ongoing support or additional work
deliverable: A handover and a clear plan for what comes next.
input: Your priorities for the next stage.
